description: Header file defining the DrmSupportInfo class, which manages DRM plugin capabilities such as supported MIME types and file suffixes, including iterators and support query methods.

classes.name: DrmSupportInfo
classes.description: Utility class encapsulating DRM plugin capabilities, supporting MIME types and file suffixes, with iterator support and comparison operators.

classes.name: DrmSupportInfo::MimeTypeIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing supported MIME types.

classes.name: DrmSupportInfo::FileSuffixIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing supported file suffixes.

methods.name: getFileSuffixIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator to traverse supported file suffixes.

methods.name: getMimeTypeIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator to traverse supported MIME types.

methods.name: getMimeTypeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of supported MIME types.

methods.name: getFileSuffixCount
methods.description: Returns the number of supported file suffixes.

methods.name: addMimeType
methods.description: Adds a MIME type to the supported list.

methods.name: addFileSuffix
methods.description: Adds a file suffix to the supported list.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets a description for the DRM plugin.

methods.name: isSupportedMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type is supported.

methods.name: isSupportedFileSuffix
methods.description: Checks if a file suffix is supported.
